title: Finiteness of Sha(E/Q): formalize Kolyvagin rank-1 result

problemStatement.plain: Formal investigation in number theory: Finiteness of Sha(E/Q): formalize Kolyvagin rank-1 result.

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Created BirchSwinnertonDyerOQ01.lean formalizing Kolyvagin SHA finiteness - builds successfully with 0 sorries, 8 axioms
builtItems: BirchSwinnertonDyerOQ01.lean: 297 lines, 8 theorems, 8 axioms, 0 sorries - builds in Docker
ShaTorsionPrimary structure: abstract type for p-primary Sha group Sha(E/Q)[p^inf]
pSelmerRank: opaque natural number encoding p-Selmer rank
HeegnerField/HeegnerPoint structures: encoding Heegner hypothesis and point existence
theorem kolyvagin_sha_finiteness: main theorem - Sha[p^inf] finite when analytic rank <= 1
theorem kolyvagin_complete: combined BSD rank equality + Sha finiteness for rank <= 1
theorem bsd_rank_le_one: BSD itself for rank <= 1 (derived from parent axioms)
Fixed BirchSwinnertonDyer.lean: /-- orphan doc comment -> /-, #check parity_conjecture -> #check parity_conjecture_proved
insights: Main BSD file had 2 pre-existing parse errors (orphan doc comment at line 5634, undefined parity_conjecture at line 5706) - fixed both
Kolyvagin rank-1 theorem requires 3 key components: (1) Heegner field via Dirichlet/Chebotarev, (2) Gross-Zagier formula connecting L-values to Heegner heights, (3) Euler system bounding Selmer rank
The p-Selmer rank formula (selmer_rank = algebraic_rank + corank(Sha[p^inf])) is the key bridge from Selmer bounds to Sha finiteness
BSD for rank <= 1 follows directly from BSD_rank_zero_axiom and BSD_rank_one_axiom in parent file

Sha finiteness for rank <= 1 requires 8 axioms beyond what parent file contains: analyticRank_pos_of_L_zero, heegner_field_exists, heegner_point_exists, gross_zagier_height_pos, 2 Kolyvagin Euler system axioms, 2 Sha finiteness from Selmer axioms
mathlibGaps: Mathlib lacks: proper Galois H1 cohomology for elliptic curves (needed for genuine Sha definition)
Mathlib lacks: Selmer group machinery at p-adic level (needed to make pSelmerRank non-opaque)
Mathlib lacks: Gross-Zagier height formula (would need Neron-Tate height pairing on E(K))
